purpose: When NOT to trade. A calendar filter removes more bad trades than any indicator adds good ones.
principle: Most signal damage comes from trading into known binary events with a technical stop that cannot protect against a gap.

hard_blocks.condition: Results date falls within horizon_days of the signal date
hard_blocks.why: A technical stop does not protect against a 15% earnings gap. The risk model assumes continuous prices; earnings break that assumption.

hard_blocks.condition: Underlying is in the F&O ban list
hard_blocks.why: Fresh positions are prohibited. A signal that cannot be acted on is noise.

hard_blocks.condition: Stock hit a circuit limit in the last 3 sessions
hard_blocks.why: Price discovery is broken. Indicators computed on circuit-locked prices are meaningless.

hard_blocks.condition: Latest bar is older than 1 trading session
hard_blocks.why: A stale signal displayed as live is the most dangerous output this system can produce.

hard_blocks.condition: Ex-date for split, bonus, or rights falls within horizon_days
hard_blocks.why: The price adjusts mechanically. Any target or stop computed on the pre-action basis is wrong.

soft_blocks.condition: RBI monetary policy decision within 2 sessions
soft_blocks.why: Rate-sensitive sectors gap on the decision. Direction is not predictable from technicals.

soft_blocks.action: Halve position size, avoid sector-specific bets.
soft_blocks.why: Tax and duty changes reprice whole sectors overnight.
Gamma and roll flows distort intraday price action.

soft_blocks.condition: Peak results season (mid-Jan, mid-Apr, mid-Jul, mid-Oct)
soft_blocks.action: Prefer setups with no results date in horizon; reduce size on the rest.
soft_blocks.why: Idiosyncratic gap risk is elevated across the whole market.

soft_blocks.action: Avoid new swing entries in the last session before the break.
soft_blocks.why: Overnight gap risk multiplies with the number of closed sessions.

never_trade_windows.why: Opening auction residue and overnight order imbalance. Spreads are widest.
Closing auction influence and position squaring. Intraday signals here are noise.

holiday_rule: Use the exchange holiday calendar, not a weekday check. NSE has trading holidays that fall on weekdays, and muhurat sessions that fall on weekends.
data_source: Corporate actions and results dates must be ingested from the exchange feed, not inferred. If the calendar is missing, treat the calendar filter as unknown and do not emit a signal.
